data.one_liner: Support for specifying test expectations via an extensible Matcher class.
data.what_it_does: Provides a third-generation assertion mechanism for Dart unit and widget tests, drawing inspiration from Hamcrest. Includes a large number of built-in matchers for values, exceptions, futures, and streams, as well as support for creating custom matchers.
use_when: You need expressive, composable assertions for unit or asynchronous tests.
You want to validate complex data structures, exceptions, or stream events.
strengths: Extensible Matcher class allows defining custom validation logic.
Rich set of built-in matchers for futures, streams, collections, and types.
Detailed failure messages providing clear context on what went wrong.
weaknesses: Does not replace the underlying test runner framework (requires package:test or similar).
